weaknesses.title: Missing authentication
weaknesses.description: An endpoint that declares a security scheme must refuse a request that carries no credentials, and the refusal must not describe the resource it is protecting.

weaknesses.title: Broken object-level authorisation
weaknesses.description: An endpoint addressed by an identifier must not serve one actor's object to another actor: the request is refused, never answered with 200.

weaknesses.title: Broken function-level authorisation
weaknesses.description: A guarded operation must refuse a caller whose role does not carry the capability, rather than relying on the caller never finding the route.

weaknesses.title: Mass assignment of a privileged property
weaknesses.description: A privileged property named in the request schema must not be settable by the client: the value is ignored or the request is refused, never silently applied.

weaknesses.title: Injection surface
weaknesses.description: Metacharacters sent into a free-text field must be handled as data: no unhandled exception, and no query, template or command fragment echoed back as an oracle.

weaknesses.title: Input validation
weaknesses.description: A value that violates a declared constraint must be rejected by the contract's own error status. An unhandled 5xx is a defect in every class.

weaknesses.title: Error handling leaks internals
weaknesses.description: However the request is malformed, the response must not carry a stack trace, a framework version, a SQL fragment or an internal hostname.

weaknesses.title: Transport and response security headers
weaknesses.description: Every response carries the transport and content-type protections, and none of the banners that name the server software and its version.

weaknesses.title: Authentication token handling
weaknesses.description: An expired token and a token whose signature was stripped are both refused; neither is accepted because its claims read correctly.

weaknesses.title: Unrestricted resource consumption
weaknesses.description: Repeated identical requests are eventually refused with 429 rather than served without limit. The probe is bounded and backs off — a QA tool must not be the outage.
